messages:
Jordan P: handing off shift — ongoing incident INC-2026-42. Brief: embeddings-eu-west p99 latency spike since ~02:10 UTC, causing intermittent 504s for two high-tier customers. Current status: degradations are isolated to eu-west inference cluster (replica set embeddings-eu-west). Mitigations applied: scaled replicas +2, enabled rate-shedding for non-paid tenants, switched traffic to fallback quantized model (quant-v2-fallback). See runbook: https://internal.runbook/redwood/incidents/INC-2026-42

Jordan P: active alerts = queue_length>8k (avg across nodes), kv-cache eviction rate high, request_queue_timeout surge. Customer impact: CS ticket #CS-8921 open for Customer A and #CS-8922 for Customer B — both report timeouts and degraded throughput. Severity: P2, elevated customer SLA risk.

Jordan P: playbook steps taken (commands):
```
# scale up embeddings pool
kubectl scale deployment embeddings-eu-west --replicas=6
# temporarily enable rate-shedding for non-paid
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://ops-api/internal/ratelimit/update -d '{"scope":"nonpaid","mode":"shed","threshold":0.6}'
```

Jordan P: logs snippet from gateway (sanitized):
```
{"ts":"2026-03-14T02:23:11Z","lvl":"error","msg":"request timeout","route":"/v1/embeddings","customer":"cust-A","latency_ms":5098}
{"ts":"2026-03-14T02:23:12Z","lvl":"warn","msg":"kv cache eviction","node":"eu-west-2b","evict_count":124}
```

Jordan P: runbook pointer: https://internal.runbook/redwood/embeddings-p99 - follow 'scale and shed' section. Escalation: if p99 > 2s for 15m or error rate > 5% escalate to Eng-Platform and Pager Duty SEV team.

Maria S: ack — I'm taking primary for the next 8h. Confirming I can reach all consoles and have creds. Quick Q: what was the observed effect of switching to quant-v2-fallback on quality? Jordan P: minor hallucination increase reported in test prompts but customer-facing requests are tolerable; we prefer availability for now.

Maria S: immediate next steps from me: 1) validate the scaled replicas actually accepted traffic and are healthy (kubectl get pods + liveness probes), 2) tail application logs for kv eviction recovery, 3) start a 10-min window check for p99 < 1s and error rate < 1% before we relax shedding.

Alex R: add to checklist — watch prefetch/cache hit ratio and active connections per node. If connections > 4k persist, consider adding another +2 replicas or enable region-failover to eu-central as temporary routing. Also confirm whether autoscaler is inhibited (sometimes manual scale requires re-enabling HPA afterwards).

SRE Bot: [incident created] INC-2026-42 | embeddings-eu-west p99 spike | pager sent to oncall@redwood at 02:12 UTC. Current status: mitigation in progress. Next automated update in 10m or on state change.

Nate D: from support/CS side — customers notified via templated update 02:35 UTC. Suggested public note drafted, will hold until we hit the stability window you defined. If we expect >30m degradation, we need exec-level notification.

Maria S: notes for whoever covers next shift: primary = Maria S, secondary = Alex R (oncall backup). Coverage gaps: no dedicated infra engineer in APAC overnight — if we see cross-region failover, CC @SRE Lead. Runbook shortcuts: use the 'embeddings-p99' dashboard filter (top-right) and the 'eviction' timeseries. Playbook command to force-prefetch TTL reset:
```
curl -X POST https://ops-api/internal/prefetch/reset -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"region":"eu-west","keys":"all"}'
```

Maria S: rollback criteria: if p99 remains > 2s AND error rate > 3% after 20m of added capacity, revert to previous model routing and start capacity rollback to original counts to avoid cascading resource contention. If we revert to previous model, coordinate with ML infra to ensure KV cache warms to avoid cold-penalty.

Jordan P: FYI — I left a quick snapshot of node resource usage in S3: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-42/metrics-02-23.json. Also left a mini-checklist in the incident doc for the next 30m.

Ops-Bot: executed: set-rate-shed nonpaid -> 60% load shedding. Command ID: ops-4567.

Maria S: taking over now. I'll post status updates every 10m or on any escalation. If anyone sees customer error spikes, ping me directly (DM). Thanks. :thumbsup:

Alex R: noted. I'm available if we need to trigger region failover.

SRE Bot: [update] autoscaler observed node pressure at 02:41 UTC; recommend manual intervention if HPA doesn't scale within 5m.

Maria S: last note before I close handoff: temp mitigation timeline estimate 30-60m to restore p99 to <1s. Adding a follow-up action: schedule a postmortem runbook check to verify whether prefetch TTLs and cache sizes need permanent tuning.

Maria S: handing off live monitoring to Grafana alerts: #embeddings-eu-west-p99 (threshold 1s), #kv-eviction-rate (threshold 50/min), #request-timeout-rate (threshold 1%).

Maria S: end of handoff.
